# Comfortable Roadtrip Planner Skill for Muse

Plan comfort-first multi-day self-drive road trips for travelers with limited stamina — pregnant travelers, seniors, or kids: fixed hotels and dates become immovable anchors, the route is built as a comfort chain (fewer backtracks, daylight driving, meal/restroom/rest breaks), and every attraction becomes a decision ranked A (keep if possible), B (do if timing and body battery allow), or C (skip freely) with a clear escape rule. The signature deliverable is a one-file interactive HTML route app — day cards with embedded maps, swipeable stop photo galleries, flip-card details, meal plans, multi-provider map links (Apple, Google, Amap, Baidu), and downloadable .ics calendar events — plus strict live-data rules (weather, closures, venue hours verified per trip). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: private details (hotel confirmations, medical notes) stay out of public artifacts only if you say so; volatile facts must be re-checked close to departure since routes go stale. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
